digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler integration test harness and absence/tombstone binding lifecycle
propositions: Integration tests for out-of-window-but-alive binding keys lack a mutation oracle to verify clear_absent behavior; the absence/tombstone cluster in binding_lifecycle (clear_absent, note_absent, note_absent_or_rekey) has only unit-tier coverage with no integration-tier change-gating contract
The existing idempotency harness cannot exercise clear_absent's real code path because all keys are seeded in-window and both call sites gate on out-of-window-but-alive keys
The bound-but-absent direct GET request in run_differs._load_reconcile_backend runs against a real Jira backend transport that 404s synthetic test keys instead of the fake transport

Extending test_reconcile_idempotency.py with a fake out_of_window key set, lifecycle clock freezing, a clear_absent spy, and monkeypatched backend wiring enables verification that clear_absent reaches, mutates zero bindings, and preserves updated_at across repeated passes

An out-of-window→deleted→alive round-trip test pins note_absent's absence recording and clear_absent's counter-reset branch at integration tier by verifying absence_404_count state transitions match the moved binding_lifecycle module's semantics

Mutation protocol (AC#2 unconditional updated_at stamp, reach regression, no-reset regression) must each drive one test RED and revert cleanly with no src/rebar changes, while all five tests (three pre-existing plus two new) pass unmutated
